title: Power Display: switching profiles does not apply color temperature — must manually re-select in menu

setup: Prepare two disposable profiles with the reported preset values, first color-only then with reported brightness/contrast; use stable monitor identification rather than copying private device paths.
prerequisites: Isolated interactive Windows setup with DDC/CI monitor supporting User1(0x0B) and8200K(0x07), ideally LG22MK430H; preserve settings/profiles and initial monitor values.
steps: 1. Select User1 then8200K profiles and record UI selection, physical color and independent VCP0x14 readback after completion.
2. Reselect the already checkmarked preset in the manual menu and record the same values.
3. Repeat with color-only and full profiles, logging loaded value, capability/visibility gate, setter dispatch, per-operation result and final readback.
4. Restore the original monitor state and profiles; identify the first divergent gate or hardware operation before implementing a correction.
reproduce.expected_result: Profile and manual selection both apply the requested physical preset; a failing trace separates missing dispatch, failed operation, later reset and misleading cached UI state.
reproduce.version_requirement: Reported PowerToys0.102.3001; compare a supported current build separately
reproduce.title: Compare profile application with direct color-temperature selection

fix_assessment.rationale: A real profile application failure is reported, but the exact failing gate/write/readback boundary is not yet proven. Conditional investigation proposal, not a completed fix design.
